ios.desc:
Turn the sky into a live flight tracker.

ARDAR is an AR flight radar and plane spotting app that places nearby aircraft directly over your camera view, so you can point your iPhone at the sky and see what is flying above you. Built for every plane spotter, aviation fan, traveler, and curious sky watcher, ARDAR makes air traffic feel visible, immediate, and real.

Use ARDAR as an AR plane spotter, flight tracker, plane radar, and air traffic radar in one simple experience. See live nearby aircraft with callsigns, altitude, speed, heading, distance, route details, aircraft type, airline info, and more. Tap a plane in the sky to focus on it, follow its flight path, and stay flight aware without digging through a traditional map-first flight tracker.

Whether you are plane spotting near an airport, watching arrivals and departures, tracking overhead flights from your backyard, or pairing the view with ATC or live ATC listening, ARDAR gives you a fast, visual way to understand the air traffic around you.

Features:
• AR aircraft labels over the real sky
• Live nearby flight tracker data
• Flight radar and plane radar views
• Air traffic radar for local aircraft
• Callsign, altitude, speed, heading, and distance
• Route, origin, and destination details when available
• Airline and aircraft identification
• Flight path and trajectory visualization
• Filters for focused plane spotting
• Apple Watch companion map for nearby air traffic

ARDAR is made for people who look up. Open the app, point at the sky, and know what is flying.
